descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 clinical study evaluating the efficacy and safety of UBT251 in MASH subjects. Subjects will be randomly assigned to UBT251 2mg-dose, 4mg-dose，6mg-dose and placebo groups. The entire trial cycle includes a 6-week screening period, a 48-week double-blind treatment period, and a 4-week follow-up period.
